title: SUYA: Antarctic ocean temperature, salinity and air temperature monitor
description:
SUYA is a desktop program that continuously collects Antarctic sea surface and subsurface temperature, salinity and coastal air temperature from public scientific APIs (NOAA METAR, Open-Meteo, NOAA OISST and MUR, SMOS and SMAP salinity, HYCOM ESPC-D-V02, Argo floats, GOSUD, World Ocean Atlas 2023 and the Windy Point Forecast API), stores every value with its provenance in SQLite and monthly Excel workbooks, and shows the data on a south-polar stereographic map with per-location profiles and time series. The interface is available in Korean and English.

Source code, documentation and installers for Windows, macOS and Linux: https://github.com/jongsu-king/SUYA
